sections.title: About Navier
paragraphs: Navier is building the vessels and operating infrastructure for next-generation maritime transportation. Our vessels create new high-speed routes; our distributed manufacturing model allows those fleets to scale rapidly; and our network of strategic maritime nodes provides the energy, service, and access required to operate them.

By standardizing control systems, operating protocols, energy interfaces, data, and payments, we can create a high-efficiency network for the distributed movement of people and goods. We secure the strategic nodes that make that movement possible, while allowing both Navier vessels and compatible vessels from other manufacturers to participate in the network.

Navier captures recurring revenue from every journey through fleet software, payments, maintenance, financing, and terminal services — and as more vessels and nodes join, the throughput and value of the entire network grow.
We are a dual-use company: through standardization, volume, and interchangeability, we can serve both commercial transportation and defense logistics with one scalable maritime ecosystem.
